risk_flags.description: The promise narrows a broad request for CLI error handling to four specific scenarios. I would ask the requester to confirm these are the intended error paths, because other existing CLI failures could remain unhandled while the contract is still satisfied.
risk_flags.span: New tests in `tests/test_cli.py` cover each of the four error paths above

risk_flags.description: The contract explicitly excludes validation for inputs that users may reasonably expect CLI error handling to catch. If negative amounts or future dates are part of the requester’s concern, this promise would leave that work undone.
risk_flags.span: No validation of business-logic constraints (e.g. negative amounts, future dates)

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the contract turns a broad CLI error-handling request into only four covered cases, leaving potentially important CLI errors outside the promise.
